title: Grilled Peruvian-Style Pork Sirloin
description: A flavorful and tender sirloin marinated in Peruvian-inspired spices, grilled to perfection. This recipe is gluten-free and perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Aji amarillo pepper
ingredients.notes: or substitute with aji panca or habanero

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine lime juice, aji amarillo pepper, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Place the pork sirloin in a large zip-top plastic bag or a shallow dish. Pour the marinade over the pork and massage to coat. Seal the bag or cover the dish with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight, flipping the pork halfway through.
Remove the pork from the marinade and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Grill the pork for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Grill the onions for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Slice the pork against the grain and serve with grilled onions and your favorite sides.
